structured.answer: If I have to pick, I'd take the second one, "2. קיבוץ לפי חברה". At least there I find the company's name first, like הראל or מור, and all its tracks under it, with the safer-sounding ones like "אג"ח סחיר" listed too. But I'm not sure of any of it, and before I move a shekel I'll ask you or the bank.

stuck.why: It opens with 'מסלולים', 'קופת גמל להשקעה' and buttons with 'מניות' and 's&p 500'. No 'פיקדון' and no 'ריבית'. I felt it wasn't for me and almost left.
I didn't understand what the difference between them was supposed to be. Number 3 has a little 'מומלץ' mark, but I didn't know who recommends it or why.
It starts with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500', English letters, and many percentages in every row. I couldn't tell where to look.
The rows looked very much like the first table, and I wasn't sure I was looking at a different option. I got tired around here.

used: The tab names '1. החברה בראש השורה', '2. קיבוץ לפי חברה', '3. טבלת חברות מול סוגים' with the 'מומלץ' mark
Company names I know: הראל, מגדל, הפניקס, כלל, מנורה
The line under the company name, e.g. 'הראל 16 מסלולים · נכסים 19.1 מיליארד'
Track names with 'אג"ח' in them, e.g. 'אג"ח סחיר', 'אשראי ואג"ח'
skimmed: The yield column '3 שנים 13.70%' and the rows that say 'פחות מ־3 שנים'
The explanation paragraphs under the tabs
skipped: The top row of buttons, like 'עוקב מדד מניות', 'שריעה', 'הלכה'
The search box and the sort buttons
Screens 7–10, never reached, so I never saw option 3 'מומלץ'
The 'מקור / מדריכים / חוקים וכללים / שאלות' tabs
unsure_meaning: עוקב מדד (and מדד here isn't the price index from the news)
the coloured circle in each row
the small 'מומלץ' mark next to option 3
not_found: Any comparison with a bank deposit or the bank's interest rate
A plain sentence saying which track is safe and can't lose
A clear explanation of whether I can withdraw the money and when
What option 3 'מומלץ' looks like: I didn't get that far

findings.what: The page opens with shares, 's&p 500' and English letters, and there isn't a word about deposits or interest. Someone like me nearly leaves on the first screen.
findings.where: Screen 1, the 'במה הכסף מושקע' buttons, and the top of screen 2

findings.what: It's very crowded: many percentages in every row, small coloured circles, numbers with no explanation. It makes me anxious.
A dark screen with grey text. The explanations under the tables are small and pale and hard to read even enlarged.
You can't tell where one option ends and the next begins. The tables look almost the same.
The 'מומלץ' option is far down. You'd have to scroll through dozens of rows before you reach it.
The high yield numbers (24.04%, 22.48%) jump out first and could mislead. Nobody says they can also go down.
Two fee columns ('מההחסכון' and 'מההפקדות') with no simple explanation of which one I actually pay.
